blocks.orig: Mount Longido is located on the edge of the town of Longido near the border with Kenya. It is possible to climb Mount Longido in one day, but it is definitely worth spending the night on the mountain and then reaching the summit on the second day. The summit is at an altitude of 2637m above sea level. The hike goes through a wooded area that leads to a rain forest higher up, and buffaloes are often seen here. Maasai warriors are your guide during the hike.
blocks.html: On the edge of the town of Longido, close to the Kenyan border, rises Mount Longido. You can climb it in a single day, but spending a night on the mountain and reaching the top on day two is well worth it. The summit stands at 2637m above sea level. The route passes through woodland that gives way to rainforest higher up, where buffaloes are frequently spotted. Throughout the hike, Maasai warriors act as your guides.
